scope: Screen lossless N4 interleaving of packed Q4 words and FP16 group coefficients for vectorized FP32 decode.
distinct_change: Keep four SIMD groups and four columns per SIMD. Interleave four adjacent N channels at each packed K word/coefficient; use uint4/ushort4 loads and componentwise FP32 fused dequant/accumulation. Keep every output lane word order and scalar SIMD reduction.
layout: packed[(n//4)*(K//8)*4+word*4+n%4]; coefficients[(n//4)*(K//64)*4+group*4+n%4]. Pad final N4 block only; real Mistral full dimensions need no padding.
memory: Compact Q4 payload size unchanged for N divisible4. Any runtime integration must explicitly budget or retire the original row-major copy, preserve prefill consumer compatibility, and give the layout a distinct immutable profile/cache identity.
gates: Round-trip every packed/scale/bias word exactly, including odd output-column tails.
Complete output parents, inactive rows, input/weight bytes and all guards exact to unmodified native blocked4 and legacy scalar controls.
Independent FP64 checks on frozen trained operands.
All active-row masks, serving contiguous strides and padded views.
Compile entire fixed profile family before any timing; no post-barrier pipeline creation.
Paired fresh serial warm/pressure timing; retain all samples and no whole-model inference until reproducible operator benefit.
